svg.title: Four Checks Before Account Activation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-and-risk-preflight; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Account Activation; subtitle: Each failed check routes to a specific correction or a stopped submission.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate check order, not risk scores. All four checks must pass for the relevant product; statutes, network contracts, and sponsor requirements impose distinct obligations.; caption: Document evidence and the decision owner; never use alternate MIDs or product labels to bypass an adverse underwriting decision.; stages: label: Credit and debit pricing; value: Pass: configure; fail: reprice and retest; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply current Visa and Mastercard debit-surcharge prohibitions separately from 15 U.S.C. 1693o-2 and 12 CFR 235.7 routing rules. For New York, test displayed credit prices and surcharge limits against General Business Law section 518.; label: ATM fee disclosure; value: Pass: enable; fail: disable fee-bearing service; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Under 12 CFR 1005.16, disclose the fee amount on screen or paper before commitment and obtain the consumer's election to continue. Preserve test evidence and confirm that cancellation avoids the fee.; label: Service scope and cash custody; value: Pass: document scope; fail: stop added services; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Analyze actual services under 31 CFR 1010.100(ff); withdrawal-only operation does not by itself establish money-transmitter status. Added transmission or exchange services require separate classification and any applicable 31 CFR 1022.380 registration work.; label: Sponsor underwriting and data controls; value: Pass: activate; fail: remediate or decline; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Verify sponsor acceptance, merchant category, applicable MATCH screening, reserves, PCI DSS responsibilities, and dispute exposure. Assess 15 U.S.C. 6801 and 16 CFR 314.3 where applicable; use Verifi RDR and Ethoca without suppressing required sponsor reporting.

rect.title: label: Credit and debit pricing; value: Pass: configure; fail: reprice and retest; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply current Visa and Mastercard debit-surcharge prohibitions separately from 15 U.S.C. 1693o-2 and 12 CFR 235.7 routing rules. For New York, test displayed credit prices and surcharge limits against General Business Law section 518.

text.title: Apply current Visa and Mastercard debit-surcharge prohibitions separately from 15 U.S.C. 1693o-2 and 12 CFR 235.7 routing rules. For New York, test displayed credit prices and surcharge limits against General Business Law section 518.

rect.title: label: ATM fee disclosure; value: Pass: enable; fail: disable fee-bearing service; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Under 12 CFR 1005.16, disclose the fee amount on screen or paper before commitment and obtain the consumer's election to continue. Preserve test evidence and confirm that cancellation avoids the fee.

text.title: Under 12 CFR 1005.16, disclose the fee amount on screen or paper before commitment and obtain the consumer's election to continue. Preserve test evidence and confirm that cancellation avoids the fee.

rect.title: label: Service scope and cash custody; value: Pass: document scope; fail: stop added services; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Analyze actual services under 31 CFR 1010.100(ff); withdrawal-only operation does not by itself establish money-transmitter status. Added transmission or exchange services require separate classification and any applicable 31 CFR 1022.380 registration work.

text.title: Analyze actual services under 31 CFR 1010.100(ff); withdrawal-only operation does not by itself establish money-transmitter status. Added transmission or exchange services require separate classification and any applicable 31 CFR 1022.380 registration work.

rect.title: label: Sponsor underwriting and data controls; value: Pass: activate; fail: remediate or decline; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Verify sponsor acceptance, merchant category, applicable MATCH screening, reserves, PCI DSS responsibilities, and dispute exposure. Assess 15 U.S.C. 6801 and 16 CFR 314.3 where applicable; use Verifi RDR and Ethoca without suppressing required sponsor reporting.

text.title: Verify sponsor acceptance, merchant category, applicable MATCH screening, reserves, PCI DSS responsibilities, and dispute exposure. Assess 15 U.S.C. 6801 and 16 CFR 314.3 where applicable; use Verifi RDR and Ethoca without suppressing required sponsor reporting.

Assumptions: Numeric values indicate check order, not risk scores. All four checks must pass for the relevant product; statutes, network contracts, and sponsor requirements impose distinct obligations.
